versions.subject: Merge PR #4396 from @kidrek - Add New Rules Related To ESXCLI Usage
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '/esxcli'
    CommandLine|contains: 'vsan'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' get'
        - ' list'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*/esxcli" CommandLine="*vsan*" CommandLine IN ("* get*", "* list*")
